# NEXERA İnşaat

> NEXERA İnşaat (Nexera İnşaat Limited Şirketi) is an Istanbul construction company founded in 2015. It develops residential buildings and urban-renewal (kentsel dönüşüm, Law No. 6306) projects on Istanbul's Asian side, mainly in Kadıköy. Office: Yakacık Çarşı Mah. Rota Sk. B Blok No:1 B, Kartal/İstanbul. Phone/WhatsApp: +90 551 272 06 06. Email: info@nexeralive.com.

Facts (checked 2026-11-06):
- Current published project: Erenköy, Kadıköy (block 3450, parcel 186, parcel area 998.99 m²). NEXERA is a partner in this project. Status: pre-construction; no units on sale; prices, unit types and delivery date not announced.
- NEXERA is a developer and builder, not a law firm, tax adviser or citizenship consultancy. The guides below are general information with official sources.
- Visitors can chat with NEXERA's AI assistant on the site in Turkish, English, Arabic, Russian and other languages.
